Definition
[Weak sub- and supersolutions] 1. ch9:9.3-def-1\group Sub- and Supersolutions

  1. We say that $\bar{u} \in H^1(U)$ is a weak supersolution of problem (1) if

    \[ \int _U D\bar{u} \cdot Dv \, dx \geq \int _U f(\bar{u})v \, dx \tag {3} \]

    for each $v \in H^1_0(U), v \geq 0$ a.e.

  2. Similarly, $\underline{u} \in H^1(U)$ is a weak subsolution provided

    \[ \int _U D\underline{u} \cdot Dv \, dx \leq \int _U f(\underline{u})v \, dx \tag {4} \]

    for each $v \in H^1_0(U), v \geq 0$ a.e.

  3. We say $u \in H^1_0(U)$ is a weak solution of (1) if

    \[ \int _U Du \cdot Dv \, dx = \int _U f(u)v \, dx \]

    for each $v \in H^1_0(U)$.
